design_note: Four atomic reference facts cover standing work shifts, 5 weeks of right plantar heel pain, peak morning first-step pain, and right foot arch tightness today, with an exact 20-word vs 20-word span alignment and 9 identical trailing tokens ('tightness today so I need to go to the').
